name: unmassk-humanizer
description: Humanize written text so it stops reading as AI. One method skill fuses the Wikipedia 'Signs of AI writing' catalog, a 3-pass rewrite process (structure, vocabulary, texture), named voices, a protect-list seam that never flattens the author's real voice, three modes (rewrite/detect/ingest), and a living corpus of dated tells. Bilingual: English + Spanish catalogs from v1. Fused from humanizer, humanize-writing, and anti-slop (all MIT); pattern lineage traces to Wikipedia's Signs of AI writing (CC BY-SA 4.0).
